ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR19] Requires Sales Billing Estimate on moving into Negotiation and again into Booking Verification, when EAA proxy (Amount, currency-converted) is >= $25K USD. Now converts Amount via CURRENCYRATE per IRM's note.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 25000,
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
OR(ISBLANK(Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c), Total_Sales_Billing_Estimate__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Billing Estimates must be updated. Please review and update the Sales Billing Forecast.
